chosen.why_this_choice: No per-dataset table in the paper; rule 3 G-mean chosen from aggregate table; rule 4 abstract names no classifier, SVM is the first classifier column reported in the results table (note: Section 4.1 lists kNN first).

win_claim.quote: The experimental results on several common imbalanced datasets show that our method ranks first more consistently than the other state-of-art oversamplers.

notes: Paper gives no per-dataset results ('The entire result is a part of the additional documents due to page limitations'; not available in Drive folder, not read). 19 KEEL/PROMISE datasets in Table 2 (p.11), incl. typo 'habarman'. Table 5/6 page rendered and checked visually; text matches print. Table 5 SVM G column: best printed is KNNOR at rank 1 (.8363); next polynom-fit-SMOTE [25] .834. Other classifiers G: DT KNNOR .823 / SMOTE .8198 (LVQ-SMOTE [31] .8356 top); KNN KNNOR .8512 / SMOTE .858 (polynom-fit-SMOTE .8611 top); MLP KNNOR .8508 / SMOTE .8342. Table 6 header columns appear mislabeled: values under 'G' (~0.70) look like F1, under 'F1' (~0.44) look like P20, under 'P20' (~0.84) look like G; copied as printed. Table 6 'Rank' column order does not follow 'Average Rank' values (e.g., CCR rank 2 with average rank 7.5). KNNOR bold/italic in Table 5 only as italics on its name; no significance marks.
